code='''def transform(grid):
    # Connect occurrences of the marked color along each row and column.
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    mark=1
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        xs=[c for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v==mark]

        ys=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]==mark]
        if len(ys)>=2:
            for r in range(min(ys),max(ys)+1):

    return out
